The '''Simra system''' was located within the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Simran hit-trap]]|system=Simra [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the security device known as the [[Simran hit-trap]].<ref name="MaraJade5">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 5|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Simra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
